name: Tretharri Grappler (CR 1)
body:
Tretharri Grappler
CR 1

XP 400
Tretharri monk 2
LE Medium humanoid (tretharri)
Init +1; Senses Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 15, flat-footed 13 (+1 Dex, +1 dodge, +3 Wis)
hp 17 (2d8+5)
Fort +5, Ref +4, Will +6
Defensive Abilities evasion

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee unarmed strike +5 (1d6+4) or mwk nunchaku +6 (1d6+4) or mwk nunchaku flurry of blows +4/+4 (1d6+4)
Ranged light crossbow +2 (1d8/19–20)
Special Attacks flurry of blows, stunning fist (2/day, DC 13)

TACTICS

Before Combat The monk drinks his potion of bull’s strength if facing more than two opponents.

During Combat The monk uses flurry of blows if fighting multiple opponents and outnumbered but prefers grappling if the odds are even. If reduced to 5 hit points or fewer, he withdraws to drink one of his potions of cure light wounds before returning to the fray.

Base Statistics

Without bull’s strength, the monk’s statistics are:
Melee unarmed strike +3 (1d6+2) or mwk nunchaku +4 (1d6+2) or flurry of blows (nunchaku) +2/+2 (1d6+2); Str 15; CMB +3 (+7 grapple); CMD 18 (+22 vs. grapple).

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 13, Con 14, Int 8, Wis 17, Cha 8
Base Atk +1; CMB +5 (+9 grapple); CMD 20 (24 vs. grapple)
Feats Dodge, Improved Grapple, Improved Unarmed Strike, Scorpion Style, Stunning Fist
Skills Acrobatics +5, Intimidate +5, Perception +8, Sense Motive +8, Stealth +5
Languages Common, Tretharri
SQ athletic, multi-armed, quadragrapple
Combat Gear potion of bull’s strength, potions of cure light wounds (2), acid (2); Other Gear light crossbow with 20 bolts, masterwork nunchaku, 23 gp
